input_root.description: Where the export zips live, e.g. s3://surveytool (zips at <input_root>/<survey>/latest/10_RAW/<name>_*.zip)

output_root.description: Where 30_PROCESSED and 35_SCORES are written, e.g. s3://surveytool. Must be remote: the job folder is deleted after the run.

name.description: Questionnaire template name as in Survey Solutions

VERSION.description: Versions to process; [] = all versions found

zip_password.description: Optional password of the export zips

parameters.description: Optional extra keys merged into conf/<env>/parameters.yml (e.g. feature overrides)
